references.text: The Lord gives an explicit command that the tribe of Levi is not to be counted together with the other Israelites
Confirms that the Levites were not mustered together with the other Israelites, as the Lord had commanded Moses
The Levites were mustered separately by the Lord's command, which explains why they were not counted among the other tribes
In the second census, the Levites were still kept separate and not counted among the children of Israel
Explains the special status of the Levites: The Lord set apart the tribe of Levi for service, and they received no inheritance among their brothers
Confirms that the tribe of Levi received no inheritance; the offerings of the Lord were their inheritance
Explains that the Levites received no portion in the land but cities to live in, and therefore were counted separately
